The foundation

Most ideas do not need more thinking. They need evidence.

1001 CAVE exists to turn everyday friction into small, finished tools. Each project begins with a problem I actually have.

It becomes useful, leaves a lesson, or gets sealed. We build one clear solution at a time.

  1. 01Personal first.

    Solve a problem that is already real.

  2. 02Small enough to finish.

    Reduce until an artifact can exist.

  3. 03Proof over promises.

    Every project must leave evidence.
